purpose: Teach: メモリアル/ハウル/ヨドバシカメラ/ポケモン/ファミコン/東宝/オカルト/サントリー

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、戦没者メモリアル公園に行かれたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I heard that customer visited the war memorial park.
lines.style: Warm, gentle recall. Soft curiosity in the voice — not interrogating, sharing. Eyes slightly distant, turning over the memory. A small smile at the edge of the words.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ハウルの動く城の映画ファンだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer is a big Howl's Moving Castle fan, apparently.
lines.style: Thoughtful, appreciative tone. Slight lift on the title name — recognising something beloved. Unhurried pace. The warmth of noticing what someone loves.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ヨドバシカメラでカメラを買われたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I heard she bought a camera at Yodobashi.
lines.style: Softer again. Observational — not judgmental, just noticing the thread. Slight pause before 'camera,' like picturing the moment. Trailing warmth.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ポケモンカードを集めてらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer collects Pokémon cards, can you believe.
lines.style: Light, gentle surprise underlying the words. Not mocking — delighted at the discovery. Warm cadence. A small laugh waiting under the surface.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ファミコン世代の方だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, she's from the Famicom generation, it sounds like.
lines.style: Appreciative nod in the voice. Slight respect in the phrasing — acknowledging a shared era of memory. Unhurried, grounded tone.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、東宝の映画を仕事にされてたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer used to work in film — at Toho, actually.
lines.style: Impressed, steady. Clear articulation on 'Toho' — weight behind the name. Respect for the path, gently spoken. No exaggeration.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、オカルト雑誌の研究家だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I found out she's a researcher — occult magazines, of all things.
lines.style: Curious delight. Slight lift on 'of all things' — the pleasure of learning something unexpected. Eyes bright. Genuinely intrigued, not gossiping.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、サントリーのウイスキーがお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, she has a real taste for Suntory whisky.
lines.style: Affectionate observation, tinged with knowing amusement. Slight pause before 'Suntory' — savouring the specificity. Warm close, trailing with understanding.
